Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest

Class HeldEyeGameTestsLogic

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest.HeldEyeGameTestsLogic
public final class HeldEyeGameTestsLogic extends Object
Coverage for HeldEye, the live eye a player sees in first person while holding a Googly Eye. Drives it directly against a mock player, setting the hurt animation and health by hand, since the held eye derives its behaviors from the holder's own vanilla-synced state on the holder's client, under the server's synced BehaviorSettings, passed here by hand. How the eye looks in the hand is verified in game.

  • Method Details

    • heldEyeBulgesWhenHurt

      public static void heldEyeBulgesWhenHurt(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A held eye bulges when its holder is hurt, at the server's growOnHitPercent; here it is 100. In game: with growOnHitPercent = 100, hold a Googly Eye in first person and take damage (a fall, a cactus); the eye in your hand bulges and settles back.

    • heldEyeHonorsServerSettings

      public static void heldEyeHonorsServerSettings(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A held eye follows the server's switches: with growOnHitPercent at 0 being hurt plays nothing, with swirlOnHeal off healing plays nothing, and with ambientBehaviors off it never plays an idle expression. In game: set those three in somegoogly-server.toml, hold a Googly Eye in first person, take damage, heal, and stand still for 40 seconds; the eye in your hand never bulges, swirls, winks, stares, or glances aside.

    • heldEyeSwirlsWhenHealed

      public static void heldEyeSwirlsWhenHealed(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A held eye swirls when its holder heals, at most once per swirlHealCooldownTicks, and a heal while something else plays is dropped. In game: hold a Googly Eye in first person, get hurt, and eat a golden apple or drink a potion of healing; the eye swirls. Heal again soon after and it doesn't.

    • heldEyePlaysIdleBehaviors

      public static void heldEyePlaysIdleBehaviors(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A held eye left alone plays an expression from the server's ambient pool now and then, and never crosses. In game: hold a Googly Eye in first person and stand still for up to 40 seconds; the eye in your hand winks, stares, or glances aside.

    • heldEyeWinksAlone

      public static void heldEyeWinksAlone(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A lone eye's blink closes it, and cross-eye, which needs a partner eye, leaves it alone. In game: hold a Googly Eye in first person until it winks; the whole eye closes and opens again.

    • heldEyeResetsWhenPutAway

      public static void heldEyeResetsWhenPutAway(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A held eye is dropped when it leaves the holder's hands and starts fresh when picked up again, in either hand. In game: hold a Googly Eye in first person while it is mid-wink, switch to another item and back, and it is at rest; move it to your off hand and it is live there too.
